coverage: Official German constitutional, social-administration, accessibility, work-safety, public-pay, budget and measurement sources for a public-authority entry listening-room proposal.

sources.title: Grundgesetz Artikel 1
supports: State authority must respect and protect human dignity.
doesNotSupport: A named listening room or staffing level at every authority entrance

sources.title: Grundgesetz Artikel 2
supports: Free development of personality, life and physical integrity are protected within the constitutional rule.
doesNotSupport: A particular entrance-room design

sources.title: Grundgesetz Artikel 3
supports: Equality and non-discrimination on grounds of disability bind public authority.
doesNotSupport: One identical accommodation for every person and building

sources.title: Grundgesetz Artikel 17
supports: Everyone may address written requests or complaints to competent bodies and legislatures.
doesNotSupport: A general oral walk-in-room duty or success on the merits

sources.title: Grundgesetz Artikel 20
supports: Germany is a democratic and social federal state and administration is bound by law and justice.
doesNotSupport: A self-executing room, appointment or payment claim

sources.title: BVerfG order of 8 June 2021, 2 BvR 1306/20
supports: Article 17 protects receipt, substantive examination and written notification of how a permissible petition was handled.
doesNotSupport: A right to the requested substantive result

sources.title: Sozialgesetzbuch I section 14
supports: Everyone has a right to advice about social-law rights and duties.
doesNotSupport: Advice outside the provision's subject-matter scope

sources.title: Sozialgesetzbuch I section 16
supports: Specified bodies accept applications, forward wrongly addressed applications without delay and assist with clear and complete applications.
doesNotSupport: Merits approval at the intake point

sources.title: Sozialgesetzbuch I section 17
supports: Service providers must work toward timely and comprehensive benefits, sufficient services, the simplest possible access and barrier-free buildings and service rooms.
doesNotSupport: A dedicated low-stimulus room with a fixed title at every entrance

sources.title: Sozialgesetzbuch I section 35
supports: The social secrecy right protects access to social data by unauthorized persons.
doesNotSupport: Automatic recording or public use of intake conversations

sources.title: Sozialgesetzbuch X section 9
supports: Social administrative procedure must be carried out simply, appropriately and swiftly.
doesNotSupport: A single mandatory organizational implementation

sources.title: Sozialgesetzbuch X section 13
supports: A participant may appear at negotiations and discussions with a support person within the statutory rules.
doesNotSupport: Unrestricted access for every third party to protected case data

sources.title: Sozialgesetzbuch X section 67a
supports: Social data collection requires a statutory task basis and generally takes place from the data subject.
doesNotSupport: A person-level satisfaction database

sources.title: Sozialgesetzbuch II section 14
supports: Jobcenter advice is oriented to individual need, a personal contact should be named, and advice can be outreach- and social-space-oriented.
doesNotSupport: A particular new job title or pay formula

sources.title: Sozialgesetzbuch III section 29
supports: The Federal Employment Agency must offer vocational and continuing-education advice according to advisory need.
doesNotSupport: A universal non-vocational ombuds mandate

sources.title: Sozialgesetzbuch III section 367
supports: The Federal Employment Agency is a direct federal public-law corporation.
doesNotSupport: Any particular disputed case fact

sources.title: Behindertengleichstellungsgesetz sections 1, 3, 4 and 7
supports: The Act covers federal public bodies including the BA, defines disability and accessibility, prohibits discrimination and recognizes proportionate reasonable accommodations in individual cases.
doesNotSupport: An identical dedicated room in every existing building regardless of circumstances

sources.title: Behindertengleichstellungsgesetz section 8
supports: Federal new, conversion and extension construction and specified existing-building measures must or should account for barrier-free design under the statutory rules.
doesNotSupport: A named listening-room entitlement independent of the building measure

sources.title: Behindertengleichstellungsgesetz section 11
supports: Federal public bodies should communicate in simple and understandable language and explain notices on request in the defined cases.
doesNotSupport: An unlimited rewriting duty or a new benefit entitlement

sources.title: Behindertengleichstellungsgesetz section 16
supports: A neutral, independent, accessible and free out-of-court conciliation procedure exists for specified BGG disputes.
doesNotSupport: A replacement for every formal remedy

sources.title: Kundenreaktionsmanagement der Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit
supports: The BA describes a nationwide neutral contact for praise, suggestions, criticism and complaints, including an anonymous route.
doesNotSupport: A physical low-stimulus room at every BA entrance
Replacement of objection or court action

sources.title: Arbeitsschutzgesetz sections 3 to 5
supports: Employers must organize occupational safety and assess physical and psychological hazards.
doesNotSupport: One nationwide security staffing model without a site-specific assessment

sources.title: Gewaltpraevention fuer Beschaeftigte im oeffentlichen Dienst
supports: Public-service customer contact benefits from spatial precautions, communication and de-escalation training, reporting and emergency planning.
doesNotSupport: A legal room duty or an identity-based risk classification

sources.title: Gefaehrdungsbeurteilung Interaktionsarbeit
supports: Communication, de-escalation, complaint management and organizational or spatial measures are possible prevention elements.
doesNotSupport: A self-executing staffing or building rule

sources.title: Leitfaden Barrierefreies Bauen
sources.institution: Bundesministerium fuer Wohnen, Stadtentwicklung und Bauwesen
supports: Federal building guidance addresses public reception areas, seating and room acoustics as accessibility design subjects.
doesNotSupport: An independent statutory claim created by the guide

sources.title: Grundgesetz Artikel 33 Absatz 2
supports: Access to public office follows aptitude, qualifications and professional performance.
doesNotSupport: Selection solely by an unmeasured vibe

sources.title: BAG judgment 8 AZR 279/20
supports: Article 33(2) also governs public-service employee posts; aptitude and qualification may include personality, general knowledge, life experience and training when objectively bound to the role.
doesNotSupport: Arbitrary appointment without a transparent profile

sources.title: Sozialgesetzbuch III section 387
supports: BA personnel are primarily employees; BA civil servants are federal civil servants.
doesNotSupport: A particular salary amount

sources.title: Tarifvertrag der Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit
supports: The BA employee pay system uses activity levels, experience stages and defined function supplements.
doesNotSupport: A 100,000-euro monthly standard role or an automatic public-satisfaction formula

sources.title: Sozialgesetzbuch III section 390
supports: A narrowly regulated performance and business-results component exists for upper BA managers and selected specialists with capped amounts, an agreed metric system and budget controls.
doesNotSupport: An unrestricted direct salary link to overall population satisfaction

sources.title: Bundesbesoldungsgesetz sections 2, 14 and 42a
supports: Federal civil-service pay and adjustments require statutory bases; performance supplements operate within statutory limits.
doesNotSupport: Creation of civil-service pay by a software output or unilateral proposal

sources.title: Grundgesetz Artikel 110
supports: Federal expenditure and revenue belong in the budget plan established by budget law.
doesNotSupport: Automatic expenditure by a research calculator

sources.title: Bundeshaushaltsordnung section 7
supports: Financial measures must observe economy and efficiency and use an appropriate economic analysis.
doesNotSupport: That the synthetic fixture is a cost estimate

sources.title: Lebenslagenbefragung 2023
supports: The 2023 life-events survey reports an overall authority-service satisfaction score and multiple life-event results.
doesNotSupport: A monthly live index of total population satisfaction
A pay entitlement

sources.title: Buerokratiekosten und Lebenslagenbefragung
supports: Destatis conducts the life-events survey every two years and publishes its method and results as a public-administration satisfaction instrument.
doesNotSupport: Use of a small entrance kiosk sample as the whole population
Direct comparison across changed methods without review
